name: hotel-platform
description: Multi-tenant hotel website, booking and management platform

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run db:check && npm run preflight:production && npm run release:acceptance
